---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the gap or annoyance this would fix — e.g. "I can't tell which
paints are low on stock without opening every paint's detail page."

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see happen. Sketches/mockups welcome if it's a UI change.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one seems better.

**Scope check**
Please skim "Things not to fix" in
[AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md#things-not-to-fix) first — a few areas (e.g.
multi-user auth, direct manufacturer-site scraping) are intentionally out of
scope for this project.

**Additional context**
Anything else worth knowing.
